title: Spring Boot Basics and REST Controllers
description: What Spring Boot adds to Spring, generating and reading a Boot project, dependency injection and bean scopes, how auto-configuration works, and REST controllers with path, query and body parameters, ResponseEntity status codes and an OpenAPI description explored in Swagger UI.
